status_rules:
VERIFIED   >= 2 independent sources return a record whose normalised title
             matches the anchor (similarity >= 0.90 to each other) with the
             expected first-author surname among the authors.
  MISMATCH   sources were found but disagree (title/author), or a seed id from
             the contract resolves to a different work than described.
  UNRESOLVED fewer than 2 sources returned a matching record.

Matching rules (v2, 2026-09-29; run 1 used v1 and is archived in logs/C/anchors_run1/)
  A search candidate matches when its first-author-list contains the expected surname and
  either (a) normalised title similarity to the query >= 0.90, or (b) >= 80% of the
  query's content words appear in the title AND >= 70% of the title's content words
  appear in the query. v1 used 0.85 for (a) and had no title-side check in (b); v1
  produced a false VERIFIED (chandola_anomaly_survey matched a different survey) and
  three MISMATCHes caused by related-but-different works (Wild-Time, a 2026 conformal
  risk control follow-up, an isolation-forest extension).
  A candidate fetched by an id (contract seed id, or a DOI/arXiv id carried by another
  source's matching record) may also match when the query starts with its title (some
  registries store the title without its subtitle).
  Crossref titles include the Crossref "subtitle" field when present.
  Cross-source agreement: titles agree when similarity >= 0.90 or one normalised title is a
  prefix (>= 2 words) of the other (a registry that drops the subtitle).
